messages:
Marta: Quick sync — two dependent PRs ready: SDK (#512) needs API change in api-service (#233). We need merge order + reviewers. @Raj can you confirm API change is merge-safe?
Raj: Saw it, running integration tests now. No schema changes, should be safe. I can review SDK after CI passes.
Anna: I'd prefer order: api -> sdk -> console -> helm -> runtime. We should cut a canary for console though.
Jen: Agree. Runtime image needs new tag from sdk build; hold runtime merge until image exists. I'll trigger build once SDK merged.
Marta: For helm chart bump I'll prepare commit:
```
helm/charts/redwood/values.yaml: image.tag: v2.1.0-sdku512
```
will do PR once console is merged.
deploy-bot: CI status — api-service#233: all checks passed ✅; sdk#512: tests failing (flaky e2e) — rerun queued.
sre-oncall: Heads up — staging deploy window opens 3pm PT. If we want a same-day canary, merge before 2:30pm.
Raj: Rerun passed. I'll finish review now, should be done in ~20m.
Anna: I can approve console PR once SDK is in main and image is available.
Marta: Action items: Raj finish API merge, Jen trigger SDK build, Anna approve console, I'll open helm bump PR after console merge. Targeting staging canary today. @everyone :thumbsup:
